description:
Represents potential issues within a customer's Microsoft Defender for Identity configuration that Microsoft Defender for Identity identified related to the sensor.

TIP: Gets a specific health issue scoped to a sensor. Equivalent to get-identity-health-issue but verified to belong to the named sensor — useful when correlating an alert to a specific DC.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

name: get-sensor-health-issue
